issues.description: The "binary" field is set to true while manifest.yaml status is "built" (not published). If "binary" means "pre-compiled binary available in Conan remote", this is inconsistent with status=built. If it means "this package produces a binary artifact", then true is correct. The rule examples (strace with binary=false) suggest the former interpretation. Recommend verifying semantics.
issues.fix_suggestion: If binary means "available in remote", change to false to match status=built. If it means "produces a binary", leave as-is. Consider documenting the field semantics in the code style rules.

issues.description: The ldflags in the manual build command include -X main.buildTime=2026-06-01T12:00:00Z, but the actual build date documented in the same file is 2026-08-06. The conanfile.py recipe only sets main.version (not commit/buildTime), so this is a documentation inconsistency only, not a recipe issue.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update the buildTime in the notes.md manual build command to match the actual build date (2026-08-06), or remove the buildTime ldflag from the documentation example.

issues.description: The homepage URL is not quoted: homepage: https://github.com/go-nv/goenv. While valid YAML, quoting string values is recommended for consistency with other YAML files in the project (code style rule 13 requires quoted strings in conandata.yml; applying the same convention to MANIFEST.yml would improve consistency).

summary: Re-audit of goenv 3.1.1 Conan recipe after fixes (W4 Pre-PR). VERDICT: PASS. All previously identified issues are confirmed FIXED: (1) R39 — conandata.yml uses single official GitHub URL (https://github.com/go-nv/goenv/archive/refs/tags/3.1.1.tar.gz) with no manual mirror prefixes; (2) test.sh uses 'set -euo pipefail' and [ok]/[fail] output markers; (3) manifest.yaml build_system is 'custom' (appropriate for Go-based build); (4) notes.md dates are consistent at 2026-08-06, with metadata timestamp (15:09) after build end (14:52). P0 DECEPTION CHECKS — ALL CLEAR: no empty shell test (test.sh executes goenv --version and greps output for 'goenv' and '3.1.1'); no skipped/faked test (test() runs real binary or checks ELF magic); no fake status (status=built is accurate for verified-but-not-published); no fake sha256 (64 hex chars, not all zeros/f); no #ifdef __OHOS__ empty stubs; no pre-compiled binaries; goenv is simple Go CLI not in R40 sensitive categories. P1 RECIPE CORRECTNESS — ALL CLEAR: R39 official URL in conandata.yml; R32 OS check includes OHOS (validate checks Linux+OHOS); R33 all env var accesses use os.environ.get() with defaults; R34 real test in test_package. P2 CODE STYLE — ALL CLEAR or ACCEPTABLE: conanfile.py has correct shebang+docstring, PascalCase class name, proper method order, correct imports, no TODO/FIXME; test.sh has pipefail, quoted variables, no || true; commands.json has 2-space indent, type='tool', no trailing comma; hardcoded paths (bash shebang, binary-sign-tool, Go candidates, test_package bash) are acceptable P2 items matching existing chkbit pattern with appropriate fallbacks (shutil.which, auto-bootstrap, os.environ.get). Three minor P3 suggestions noted: commands.json binary field semantics, notes.md buildTime date mismatch in manual build docs, and unquoted homepage in MANIFEST.yml. No P0/P1 issues — PR is ready for merge.
